articles.summary: Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions announced the official launch of Supreme Defense™ Gloss Lite Paint Protection Film, an exceptional 7.5-mil clear PPF engineered to bring high-volume installation versatility and a smarter price point to the Supreme Defense PPF portfolio of films.
articles.title: Avery Dennison® Expands Wet-Apply Paint Protection Film Portfolio with 7-Year Clear Film Option at a Smarter Price Point

articles.summary: Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions (NYSE:AVY) today premiered an industry-leading training and certification program for Architectural Window Film installation. The new Architectural Window Film Certification empowers installers to validate expertise and stand out in a competitive market.
articles.title: Avery Dennison® Debuts New Architectural Window Film Training and Certification Program

articles.summary: Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions today debuted Rehlm™ Architectural Finishes, a portfolio of textured, patterned films crafted to transform interior spaces. Rehlm Architectural Finishes are available for purchase on Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions' newly launched e-commerce platform – the division's first public online store, allowing installers to purchase products directly from the company.
articles.title: Avery Dennison® Debuts Rehlm™ Architectural Finishes Portfolio, Introduces New, Public e-Commerce Website
